generator: tools/interop-v2-reference.py (CPython stdlib, incl. pure-Python LZ4 block codec)
cross_checked_by: tools/interop-v2-crosscheck.mjs (independent container parser + LZ4 block decoder + WebCrypto HKDF/AES-GCM; zero dependencies)

security_limits.note: All enforced BEFORE decompression, integer arithmetic only — spec/interop-v2.md#security-limits-decompression-bounds

compressed_bytes_note: method-1 payload bytes are NOT canonical: conformant LZ4 encoders legally differ. Vectors pin the reference compressor's output for READ-side conformance; writers may produce different valid LZ4 for the same value.
error_vectors_note: reject_* vectors MUST be rejected with an error; the 'error' text is a maintainer note, not a normative message.

container_vectors.name: method0_issue_example
container_vectors.description: method 0 (no compression) wrap of the v1 issue_example_object value — original_size MUST equal the payload length

container_vectors.name: lz4_roundtrip_compressible
container_vectors.description: method 1 compressed round-trip of a redundant value. The payload is the REFERENCE compressor's output: readers MUST decompress it to the pinned value bytes; writers are NOT required to reproduce these compressed bytes (compressed bytes are non-canonical, read-side conformance only)

container_vectors.name: lz4_wraps_v1_value_vector
container_vectors.description: method 1 container over the SAME plain bytes as v1's issue_example_object value vector — the inner value profile is inherited from v1 unchanged. Incompressible at this size: the LZ4 payload is a literals-only block LARGER than the value (writers SHOULD have used method 0; readers MUST still accept it)

aad_vectors.name: interop_v2_aad
aad_vectors.description: AAD v0x03 over the same tenant + interop key as v1's interop_key_aad; the two AADs differ ONLY in the final component (frozen tokens 'True' vs 'False') — this is the cryptographic mode separation

encryption_vectors.name: interop_v2_compressed_encryption_roundtrip
encryption_vectors.description: Full v2 round-trip: HKDF-SHA256 per spec/encryption.md (same master key + tenant as interop/v1 and encryption.json, hence the same derived key), AES-256-GCM over the ENTIRE v2 container bytes (lz4_roundtrip_compressible) with the v2 AAD (compressed='True') and a fixed nonce.

reject_vectors.name: reject_bad_magic_v1_value
reject_vectors.description: A bare interop/v1 value fed to a v2 reader: first byte is a msgpack marker, not 0xC1
reject_vectors.error: bad magic; reader SHOULD diagnose 'possible interop/v1 value'

reject_vectors.name: reject_unknown_method
reject_vectors.description: method 2 is not in the registry

reject_vectors.name: reject_payload_array_of_ints
reject_vectors.description: Payload encoded as a msgpack array of integers instead of bin — the legacy ByteStorage leniency is explicitly NOT inherited by interop/v2

reject_vectors.name: reject_payload_str
reject_vectors.description: Payload encoded as the msgpack str family instead of bin

reject_vectors.name: reject_trailing_bytes
reject_vectors.description: Valid container followed by one extra byte

reject_vectors.name: reject_declared_size_bomb
reject_vectors.description: original_size declares 1 TiB — exceeds the 512 MB cap (checked BEFORE decompression)

reject_vectors.name: reject_ratio_bomb
reject_vectors.description: 10-byte payload declaring 10001 output bytes — exceeds the 1000:1 ratio (checked BEFORE decompression)

reject_vectors.name: reject_lz4_zero_offset
reject_vectors.description: LZ4 sequence with match offset 0 (invalid in the block format)

reject_vectors.name: reject_lz4_truncated
reject_vectors.description: The lz4_roundtrip_compressible payload with its last 3 bytes removed

reject_vectors.name: reject_lz4_length_mismatch
reject_vectors.description: Valid LZ4 block whose output is one byte short of original_size
reject_vectors.error: LZ4 output length != original_size (also fine to fail as overrun, depending on decoder structure)

crypto_reject_vectors.name: reject_v2_ciphertext_with_v1_aad
crypto_reject_vectors.description: The v2 ciphertext MUST fail AES-GCM authentication under the v1 AAD (compressed='False')
crypto_reject_vectors.error: authentication failure — cross-mode read, terminal per the no-retry rule

crypto_reject_vectors.name: reject_v1_ciphertext_with_v2_aad
crypto_reject_vectors.description: interop/v1's published interop_encryption_roundtrip ciphertext MUST fail under the v2 AAD (compressed='True')
crypto_reject_vectors.error: authentication failure — cross-mode read, terminal per the no-retry rule
